title: La vuelta al mundo de un novelista; vol. 2/3
summary: "La vuelta al mundo de un novelista; vol. 2/3" by Vicente Blasco Ibáñez is a travel narrative published between 1924 and 1925. The Spanish writer recounts his journey around the world aboard the Cunard cruise ship Franconia from November 1923 to March 1924. This second volume chronicles his travels through China, Macao, Hong Kong, the Philippines, Java, Singapore, Burma, and Calcutta, weaving together historical, geographical, cultural, and political observations from the interwar period.
